name: Hebei University of Science and Technology

evidence.summary: HEBUST says it obtained a Grade 2 secrecy qualification for weapons and equipment research and production units in May 2014, and military-standard (GJB) quality management certification in September 2015.

It has been co-built by the Hebei government and SASTIND since September 2013, renewed for 2016–2020, with SASTIND supporting three of its defence-specialty disciplines and six defence-related majors.
